title: Single-nucleotide polymorphisms in DNA repair genes ERCC, XRCC, and MGMT and implications in glioblastoma: a pathway analysis and structural dynamics study.
authors: Afshar, Yashmin; Naseri, Aida; Amoozadehsamakoosh, Amirmohammad; Naseri, Alma; Abrishami, Melika; Yazdanpanah, Niloufar; Saleki, Kiarash; Rezaei, Nima
one_liner_zh: 该文研究GBM相关DNA修复基因SNV对蛋白结构动态的影响，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作相关通路但非TF-DNA结合体系，且方法为MD模拟但缺乏互作建模，相关性有限。
abstract: Genes partaking in DNA damage repair (DDR) pathways exert a key role in the progression of glioblastoma (GBM) and treatment resistance. Essential DDR genes, including XRCC, ERCC, and MGMT, are mutated in GBM, with single nucleotide variants (SNVs) clinically linked to the. However, the structural consequences and biophysical alterations to protein dynamics linked to RCC/MGMT SNVs in GBM are not well-studied. We analyzed GBM-related SNVs in XRCC2, XRCC3, ERCC2, and MGMT. Structural Alphafold models were built. Eight molecular dynamics simulation (MDS) runs for up to 100 ns were carried out via an all-atom forcefield. Structural analyses, such as H-bond, RMSD, RMSF, gyration, and SASA were evaluated. Moreover, protein-protein interactions (PPIs) and mRNA expression levels were assessed by STRING/Cytoscape. The SNVs, XRCC2 (Arg188His), XRCC3 (Thr241Met), ERCC2 (Lys751Gln), and MGMT (Leu84Phe), were associated with notable structural changes. MDS study revealed increased flexibility, compactness, as well as alterations in H-bonding and solvent exposure in mutants of several DDR pathway genes compared to wild-type RCC/MGMT proteins. The modified regional flexibility for all genes was identified by RMSF computation. Pathway analysis showed XRCC3 as the most connected hub within the DDR network. Upregulation of DDR genes, in particular XRCC2/MGMT, correlated with a poorer clinical outlook. A statistically meaningful and direct positive correlation of ERCC2 and MGMT was shown (p < 0.05). The present investigation indicated the significance of GBM-associated DDR gene SNVs in protein dynamics and GBM pathogenesis. This study suggests notable changes in the biophysical structural parameters of mutated ERCC2 and XRCC3, whereas changes in certain parameters of mutant XRCC2/MGMT were less prominent.
abstract_zh: 参与DNA损伤修复（DDR）途径的基因在胶质母细胞瘤（GBM）的进展和治疗耐药中发挥关键作用。包括XRCC、ERCC和MGMT在内的必需DDR基因在GBM中发生突变，其中单核苷酸变异（SNVs）在临床上与之相关。然而，与GBM中RCC/MGMT SNVs相关的蛋白质动力学的结构后果和生物物理改变尚未得到充分研究。我们分析了XRCC2、XRCC3、ERCC2和MGMT中与GBM相关的SNVs。构建了结构性的Alphafold模型。通过全原子力场进行了八次长达100 ns的分子动力学模拟（MDS）运行。评估了结构分析，如氢键、RMSD、RMSF、回旋半径和SASA。此外，通过STRING/Cytoscape评估了蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPIs）和mRNA表达水平。SNVs，即XRCC2（Arg188His）、XRCC3（Thr241Met）、ERCC2（Lys751Gln）和MGMT（Leu84Phe），与显著的结构变化相关。MDS研究显示，与野生型RCC/MGMT蛋白相比，多个DDR途径基因突变体的灵活性、紧凑性增加，以及氢键和溶剂暴露的改变。通过RMSF计算识别了所有基因的修饰区域灵活性。通路分析显示XRCC3是DDR网络中最连接的枢纽。DDR基因的上调，特别是XRCC2/MGMT，与较差的临床预后相关。ERCC2和MGMT之间显示出统计学上显著且直接的正相关（p < 0.05）。本研究指出了GBM相关DDR基因SNVs在蛋白质动力学和GBM发病机制中的重要性。该研究表明，突变的ERCC2和XRCC3的生物物理结构参数发生显著变化，而突变XRCC2/MGMT的某些参数变化则不太显著。
